decisions.title: Autonomy, publishing routing and blocked infrastructure

tasks.title: Establish an isolated execution baseline
steps: Inventory source, applicable AGENTS.md, available tools, architecture and existing Git metadata; record source SHA-256 and preserve user changes.

Create an explicit repository/source allowlist and exclude local agent runtimes, credentials, node_modules, debug pages and generated artifacts. Initialize local Git only during an authorized implementation run if no repository exists.
Create task branches without tracking, verify upstreams immediately, and implement the resume-safe status/evidence protocol from the runbook.
accept: Baseline includes the 289099-byte/8196-line reviewed source or explicitly records a newer input hash.
No workspace secrets or local runtime directories are staged; all new task branches have no upstream until an authorized same-name push.
All independent local work can continue if GitHub authentication is absent.

tasks.title: Create reliable source and artifact test infrastructure
steps: Select Node 24, retain locked legacy Puppeteer dependencies, and pin exact root development dependencies according to DEC03 below.
Implement shared GAME/CHROME/BASE_URL configuration, isolated browser storage, usable-renderer readiness, bounded test timeouts, sequential legacy suite enumeration and finally-block cleanup.
Add a prefix-only static server and machine-readable results; repair the stale V6 signature assertion without weakening its speed-kick requirement.
Add initially failing regression cases from the acceptance catalog. Keep behavioral failures visible until their owning fixes land.

Guard legacy mutable window exports behind a source-test-only compile flag and provide the instrumented source adapter; repair internal dependencies on those globals. Ordinary source play and the production build must work with all mutable test controls absent.
accept: Source and built-page targets can be selected without editing test scripts.
Startup failure, unsupported required rendering or assertion failure returns nonzero; no browser or server remains running after failure.
All 20 static and all 26 existing browser suites are explicitly accounted for; measurement-only scripts become objective gates where criteria exist.
Failure evidence records page errors, console errors, architecture, browser versions, screenshots and trace paths.

tasks.title: Build an entirely local static distribution
steps: Retain snake-three.html as canonical editable source; extract its inline module and bundle with pinned three@0.169.0 using esbuild ESM, splitting false and no published source maps.
Remove the production CDN import map and inline module; insert a relative content-hashed script URL. Include SMAAPass and its required embedded resources.
Emit only the approved dist payload, a source-compatible snake-three.html alias and a relative-link 404 page. Actions-backed Pages does not need .nojekyll; do not emit transport-excluded dotfiles.
Add structural dependency, symlink, size, secret-path and network-reference checks. Preserve original upstream license text.
Define the source-test compile flag false, eliminate its guarded adapter from the production bundle, and assert that no mutable simulation/debug globals are exposed in the actual dist page.
accept: Two clean builds from one lockfile produce byte-identical payloads and digest manifests.
The game and SMAA load with every external request blocked under both / and /just-snake/.
dist contains no source documents, plans, test hooks, credentials, debug pages or node_modules.
Package limits and entry-point rules in DEC03/DEC10 pass.

tasks.title: Eliminate URL and stored-data HTML injection
steps: Parse and bound URL values according to DEC05; treat display values from URLs, storage and errors as text.
Replace unsafe summary/leaderboard interpolation with text-node construction or a documented escaping helper; audit every remaining innerHTML assignment.
Keep structural trusted templates isolated from all data values; handle overlength and unsupported rule parameters with the exact fallback copy.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.

Initialize the existing RUN_STATS.setupUI bindings and guard pre-summary Share to exercise poisoned stored leaderboard data through actual UI; this is a minimal early subset of B04, whose full lifecycle/visibility/idempotence work remains pending.
accept: ACC-SEC-01 through ACC-SEC-03 pass in source and distribution.
A malicious seed creates no injected element, handler, script execution or unexpected network request.
Valid encoded Unicode seeds round-trip without changing their canonical bytes.

tasks.title: Restore settings and define requested versus effective graphics
steps: Validate and migrate settings into the DEC06 schema; retain presence information for explicit preferences.
Apply loaded requested preferences after renderer creation in the documented order; derive effective settings without overwriting stored requests.
Add Auto quality selection, make keyboard graphics shortcuts use the settings controller, and remove mutable wrap from settings while preserving mode-owned boundaries.
Use memory fallback on storage denial and render selected options with aria-pressed.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-SET-01 through ACC-SET-04 pass.
Reload preserves low/off/none/segments and explicit accessibility settings; Auto detection never becomes a saved manual override.
A graphics safety downgrade is reported as effective state while requested state remains persisted.
Changing graphics never changes the captured challenge tuple or gameplay state.

tasks.title: Make modal navigation and keyboard input coherent
steps: Implement the DEC07 modal state table, focus capture/trap/restore and inert background behavior.
Return from global gameplay shortcut handling while a modal or editable target owns focus; preserve native Enter/Space button activation.
Bind explicit Resume, Restart and Return to title actions and expose score/length/simulation time while paused.
Make ready-screen directional takeover use the selected key map and apply its first accepted direction.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-INPUT-01 through ACC-INPUT-04 pass.
Space/Enter in settings activates only the focused control; R cannot restart beneath the modal.
Escape closes settings without silently resuming a run; Resume resumes exactly once.
Keyboard focus cannot reach obscured background controls.

tasks.title: Complete accessibility preferences and rendering behavior
steps: Use system media preferences when no explicit override exists; react to later media-query changes only in inherited mode.
Gate shake, grain, chromatic aberration, FOV kicks, dolly/death push-in and Dutch roll under reduced motion; keep a stable fitted camera and essential gameplay motion.
Provide visible focus, selected-state semantics, sparse status announcements and the established colorblind-safe silhouette palette.
Ensure HUD/record animations honor the in-game preference, including when OS reduced motion is false.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-A11Y-01 through ACC-A11Y-04 pass.
Computed camera state stays stable through eat/death with reduced motion enabled; assertions inspect rendered state, not setter calls.
All menu controls have accessible names and focus states; no critical/serious automated accessibility finding remains in title/settings/summary.
Essential motion-dependent gameplay is described accurately; no claim of screen-reader-complete gameplay is made.

tasks.title: Repair player lifecycle, metrics and summary actions
steps: Initialize RUN_STATS and action bindings once at boot; reset run metrics, HUD and effects at player start.
Capture immutable run configuration and prior best at start; finalize each run idempotently from the simulation outcome.
Replace ambiguous generic .hidden usage with hidden attributes plus safe scoped styling; show Share only for finalized player summaries.
Separate authoritative speed/food/combo metrics from HUD DOM reads and retain documented legacy hook aliases.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-RUN-01 through ACC-RUN-03 pass.
Each player run produces exactly one summary and one eligible leaderboard insertion; repeated finalize is harmless.
Ready/pause actions are truly invisible and unfocusable; summary actions respond to real clicks.
First positive eligible score can establish a record, and restart clears old summary/record effects.

tasks.title: Isolate attract mode from player state
steps: Introduce explicit player/demo run ownership with separate simulation/RNG context or equivalently isolated state containers.
Include pillars, wrap rules, growth-aware tail occupancy and both prey in pathfinding safety.
Handle all demo terminal outcomes through bounded demo reset without player finalization, record updates, haptics or audio.
Restore player HUD and storage view independently; title-demo failure must never replace the title overlay.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-DEMO-01 and ACC-DEMO-02 pass.
Forced pillar/self/trap/target outcomes leave player best, summary and all player storage byte-identical.
A 3000-step demo stress run cycles without entering a player Game Over.
Player takeover resets score, length, timers and RNG deterministically.

tasks.title: Reset all seeded state before spawning a new run
steps: Clear both prey occupancy, visibility, entity timers/hop flags, queues and effects before replaying RNG or spawning.
Generate hazard layout once from the hazard stream and spawn first then second prey in stable entity order.

Use the immutable challenge tuple and DEC05 mode precedence. Keep an active run pinned; every new today-intent run, including Play again and paused Restart, resolves the current UTC date. Explicit custom/pinned DAILY-date requests replay identically.
Implement bounded spawn search plus deterministic free-cell fallback; never spin indefinitely on a nearly full board.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-SEED-01 through ACC-SEED-03 pass.
Clean starts, repeated Frenzy restarts and starts after demo activity produce identical opening snapshots for one tuple.
The old second prey cannot alter PRNG consumption.
Tail-cell hand-off, growing-tail exclusion and Calm wrap invariants remain correct.

tasks.title: Move gameplay time and prey decisions out of rendering
steps: Implement the event-time simulation contract DEC04 with integer milliseconds, stable event ordering and separate cosmetic clocks.
Move golden expiry, combo decay, jittery escape and run duration into simulation; rendering may read and interpolate but never mutate gameplay.
Use stable tie ordering for escape/free-cell choices; expose deterministic test snapshots and manual simulation advance only through the test adapter.
Record mode-dependent maximum speed from authoritative timing, not DOM, and keep death slow motion cosmetic.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-SEED-04, ACC-TIME-01 and ACC-TIME-02 pass.
Identical input traces produce identical snapshots at 30/60/120 FPS and batched rendering for every mode and graphics tier.
Pause and hidden-tab time consume no golden/combo/run duration; simultaneous timer/eat events follow DEC04.
No gameplay RNG or gameplay state mutation remains in draw/update-cosmetic paths.

tasks.title: Version and partition device-local records
steps: Implement DEC06 summary/records schemas, strict numeric/string validation, runId deduplication and memory fallback.
Partition top tens and bests by mode/rules and challenge category; retain seed/daily identity and keep legacy records in a labeled legacy view.
Use deterministic tie-breaks and bounded retention; preserve legacy storage without falsely assigning unknown seed/rules eligibility.
Write record state only after eligible player finalization and keep displayed in-progress record feedback separate.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-STORE-01 through ACC-STORE-03 pass.
Daily/custom/casual/legacy records never mix unfairly, and duplicate finalization cannot duplicate records.
Malformed JSON, invalid numbers, oversized arrays and denied storage do not prevent playing or same-session rankings.
Mode, canonical seed, daily date and rules survive reload and share round-trip.

tasks.title: Handle focus loss and rendering recovery
steps: Pause player simulation and suspend audio on visibility loss, window blur and context loss; clear held pointer/input state.
Never auto-resume on return. Offer an explicit Resume action and retain the run if GPU context restores successfully.
On unsupported WebGL or failed restore show exact recoverable fallback copy; expose Reload only as an explicit user action.
Separate boot import failure, GPU failure and runtime error diagnostics; do not misreport every failure as a CDN problem.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-RECOVER-01 and ACC-RECOVER-02 pass.
Hidden/background duration cannot kill a run or expire gameplay timers.
A restored GPU context rebuilds targets/effects without duplicating event listeners or losing cells/score.
Unsupported rendering produces accessible feedback rather than a dead Start button or an error loop.

tasks.title: Make touch, haptics and fullscreen reliable
steps: Track one active primary pointer id, use pointer capture and clear pad state on pointercancel/lostcapture/blur/visibility loss.
Retain the 20px continuous-steering threshold and queue depth 3; keep browser gesture suppression limited to the play canvas.
Require eligible player state plus user activation before vibration; treat missing/false vibration as supported degradation without console noise.
Feature-detect fullscreen and display unavailable state or omit its control when unsupported; catch promise rejection and synchronize state.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-TOUCH-01 and ACC-TOUCH-02 pass with synthesized touch events.
Second fingers cannot steal steering, canceled gestures never stick, and scrolling inside settings remains usable.
No navigator.vibrate user-activation warning appears in the real start-click flow.
Unsupported haptics/fullscreen never breaks play or presents a misleading active control.

tasks.title: Provide clear first-play and return-to-title flows
steps: Apply the exact copy/content decisions DEC08 while preserving the current visual identity and mode names.
Show concise device-appropriate steering help, length-60 goal and optional How to play details covering prey, combos and pillars.
Add Choose mode/Return to title from pause and summary; retain last mode/settings and select a new casual seed only when starting a new casual run.
Keep title primary actions simple and move technical controls into an initially collapsed Advanced graphics section.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-NAV-01 and ACC-NAV-02 pass.
A player can finish a run, change difficulty and start again without reloading.
All three prey rules and the target goal are discoverable without an unskippable tutorial.
Title/demo and restart flows do not overwrite pinned challenge settings.

tasks.title: Make menus and HUD fit small and zoomed viewports
steps: Add safe-area-aware controls/HUD, bounded panel heights and vertically scrollable dialog content.
Use at least 44x44 CSS-pixel menu/action targets, readable 14px control text and explicit focus styles; permit labels to wrap.
Prevent score/best/top-right controls from overlapping; retain visible essential board area and avoid desktop-key legends on touch-only presentation.
Validate the DEC09 viewport matrix, 200% zoom/text scale and scrolling under synthesized touch.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-RESP-01 through ACC-RESP-03 pass.
At 844x390 and 320x568, all settings and Done/close actions are reachable without horizontal page scrolling.
Title, paused, summary, leaderboard and error panels remain operable at 200% scale.
No HUD control occludes another interactive target; touch targets and safe-area padding meet the contract.

tasks.title: Share playable challenge links with a local fallback
steps: Construct challenge links from the actual current site base, canonical seed, explicit mode and rules=2; freeze daily date by sharing its concrete seed.
Copy exact DEC08 summary text using clipboard only after the Share click; provide a selectable readonly text field if clipboard is denied.
Label rankings On this device and implement mode/category filters without implying online rankings.
Keep feedback in a status region and never send messages, post to social accounts or invoke paid services.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-SHARE-01 and ACC-SHARE-02 pass.
A copied challenge URL produces the same opening tuple under project-prefix hosting.
Clipboard denial still leaves a complete copyable challenge card.
No share action causes external transmission other than the user choosing to copy text.

tasks.title: Correct speed, records and food-count atmosphere
steps: Drive speed progress and MAX level from each mode's actual base/minimum/speed increment per DEC02.
Initialize prior-best snapshots, show eligible record feedback for positive new best, and reset all record/level effects on a new run.
Drive zones by successful prey count at 10/20/30/40 eats, capped at zone4, independently of prey points and multiplier.
Give demo atmosphere a separate food counter and keep HUD changes gated to changed values.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-HUD-01 and ACC-HUD-02 pass.
Classic/Calm/Frenzy cap levels are 15/16/13 respectively; MAX appears only at the actual speed floor.
Record feedback works for fresh and existing players without demo contamination.
Atmosphere changes on the tenth prey even when score differs through combos/types.

tasks.title: Instance contact shadows without changing gameplay
steps: Replace per-segment shadow meshes with three preallocated InstancedMesh opacity buckets, keeping current taper/position/quality behavior.
Preallocate capacity for all 441 cells plus fixed pooled objects and update only active instance ranges.
Retain the continuous tube and segments fallback; preserve bloom ownership and resource cleanup.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-PERF-01 passes in tube and segments modes.
The contact-shadow pass adds at most three draw calls independent of snake length.
Cell simulation and challenge snapshots are unchanged; no per-frame geometry/material allocation is introduced.
Golden/low-quality visibility and shadow appearance pass a bounded desktop/mobile screenshot review.

tasks.title: Bound resize allocations and idle particle work
steps: Coalesce resize events into one pending animation-frame resize with final-size verification and no rebuild when effective dimensions are unchanged.
Dispose replaced render targets and cancel scheduled work on shutdown/context loss.
Maintain particle active indices/count; skip both full-array scanning and attribute uploads when no particle is alive.
Keep the existing live-upload gate while measuring actual buffer/render-target resource counts.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-PERF-02 and ACC-PERF-03 pass.
One burst of 100 resize events schedules at most one rebuild per rendered frame and settles to correct final dimensions.
After effects expire, particle CPU updates and uploads are zero until the next burst.
Repeated resize/quality/restart cycles do not monotonically grow retained target/material/program counts.

tasks.title: Measure budgets and gate expensive rendering by tier
steps: Publish a reproducible native benchmark helper/command before the fresh exclusive before measurement; no dependency on ignored artifact scripts. Separate same-GPU local relative timings from hosted structural evidence.
Record draw calls/triangles/programs/resources at length3/20/60 for each mode/tier, with native GPU versus SwiftShader clearly separated.
Default touch/coarse devices to Auto balanced and permit safe downgrade; keep costly clearcoat/sheen/reflections/extra lights for high only when budget evidence supports them.
Profile the ground/non-snake materials and sweeping light; reduce measured unnecessary per-fragment cost on balanced/low while preserving high identity.
Enforce structural/resource/package budgets from DEC09; treat unmeasured real-device frame rate as an explicit limitation, not an invented pass.

Migrate the listed legacy assertions only where an explicitly superseded rule or interface requires it. Preserve equivalent behavioral coverage and record the old/new expectation; never silence a suite to make it pass.
accept: ACC-PERF-04 passes and performance evidence covers all required lengths/tiers.
There is no release-blocking rendering regression or unbounded growth in repeated runs.
Balanced/low remain visibly readable and do not change challenge state.
No hardware frame-rate promise is based solely on software-rendered timing.

tasks.title: Prepare public metadata, documentation and license notices
steps: Set the public title, heading, share-card and social-preview name to just-snake, add the fixed description/controls/local-storage explanation from DEC08, and provide a distinctive code-native SVG favicon.
Generate a 1200x630 social preview from a deterministic gameplay capture plus plain title typography; avoid requiring image-generation credentials.
Include exact third-party notices for shipped dependencies; preserve any existing source license and do not invent ownership or grant a new license.
Document local setup, commands, source-versus-dist layout, scope of browser evidence and bug-report links derived from repository discovery.
accept: ACC-PACK-03 passes.
Public docs make no claim of global rankings, physical-device certification or a source license that was never granted.
No placeholder URLs appear in production metadata; absolute canonical/social URLs are emitted only when the deployment URL is known.
Assets are local, reproducible and within distribution budgets.

tasks.title: Create required CI checks and Pages deployment workflows
steps: Implement required qualify/publish:discover/verify:live commands, strict engine selectors and sanitized independent attestation/input identity before E04 freeze. Local rehearsal never self-declares final independent qualification.
Implement ARM64 build/source/Chromium/Firefox and ARM64 macOS WebKit jobs with pinned dependencies/actions, one browser worker and bounded timeouts.
Test the exact static artifact at root and prefixed mount; preserve/compare its digest across test/upload/deploy stages.
Allow deployments only for the discovered default branch or explicit authorized workflow dispatch, never for untrusted PR code; keep deploy credentials out of test jobs.
Use github-pages, minimum deploy permissions, explicit needs and deployment concurrency without canceling active deployments. Do not add manual approval steps.

Implement publishing discovery, live verification and rollback tooling now, before E04 freezes the candidate. Validate workflow graph/permissions and execute its entry commands with local failure injection; actual hosted run proof belongs to E05.

Retain qualified dist plus digest/provenance/report in a separate generic Actions artifact for 30 days or the repository's lower enforced maximum. Rollback downloads a selected previously qualified artifact, verifies its provenance/digests, re-uploads it as a Pages artifact in the current run, then deploys and verifies. Missing/expired prior artifacts mean rollback unavailable, never unchecked-code fallback.

Rehearse rollback selection, digest/provenance validation and re-upload mechanics locally without replacing a successful live deployment; production rollback is failure recovery, not a routine success-path drill.
accept: ACC-CI-01 and ACC-CI-02 pass.
Every release-critical suite runs and every nonzero result blocks artifact deployment.
Only the checked dist artifact is uploaded; PR jobs cannot publish.
Action versions are recorded as verified immutable commit SHAs, and existing protection rules remain intact.

tasks.title: Reconcile historical backlog, specs and obsolete scripts
steps: Replace historical claims with accepted/partial/open/deferred status and link evidence; include V11 and the new current baseline.
Mark superseded spec sections explicitly, including wall-wrap preferences, six-second golden lifetime and simulation-owned timers.
Audit stale generator/implementer scripts for references; archive them as historical and remove the unreferenced _game.js after reference checks.
Document all compatibility hooks and test adapter behavior; old recipe plans are never used as new implementation instructions.
accept: ACC-DOC-01 passes.
Every accepted item links to an assertion/evidence; outstanding G5/G8/P2/module work remain explicit and correctly ordered.
There are no contradictory authoritative constants or false DONE claims.
Historical material is preserved or intentionally archived; unreferenced broken copies cannot enter the release payload.

tasks.title: Independently qualify the immutable release candidate
steps: Run all release-required acceptance cases from a fresh install against source and the exact clean-built dist artifact.
Perform independent bounded code/visual review with desktop/portrait/landscape captures and verify no known regression remains.
Produce the DEC11 report with hashes, versions, full result matrix, evidence paths, limitations and explicit eligible-to-publish verdict.
Route any failure to its owning task and repeat only affected suites plus the final integrated qualification after fixes.
accept: All release-required cases pass; no P0/P1 issue remains unresolved.
Evidence proves source-to-build-to-tested-artifact identity and contains no secrets.
Browser/viewport evidence is distinguished from actual hardware testing.
The reviewer did not implement the changes they are qualifying; no self-approved incomplete release is marked accepted.

tasks.title: Discover and publish through existing authorized GitHub access
steps: Discover authorization, remotes, authenticated account, repo permissions/default branch, Pages settings and deployment protections using read-only calls first.

Apply DEC12 publication routing: reuse an authorized repository named exactly just-snake, or create just-snake under the authenticated personal account only in an explicitly authorized publish run. Name conflicts produce blocked_external; never choose a fallback slug or overwrite unrelated contents.
Push only a verified same-name task/release refspec, create a PR and use normal auto-merge/checks when permitted; never bypass protected-branch requirements.

Enable Actions-backed Pages when permissions allow, trigger the verified workflow and record returned deployment identity. Otherwise record a sanitized external blocker and keep all local artifacts complete.

Run the already qualified publication/discovery scripts without editing them; require successful actual hosted checks/workflow and artifact identity evidence before deployment. Local workflow rehearsal is not represented as a hosted CI pass.
accept: ACC-PUBLISH-01 passes when publication authorization/access exists.
Any pushed branch tracks remote/same-name and never the default branch accidentally.
Missing credentials/protected review/Pages permissions produce a specific blocked_external result, with no repeated clarification questions or invented success.
No unrelated workspace files are published; existing Pages custom-domain/protection settings are preserved.

tasks.title: Verify the live deployment and provide automated rollback
steps: Poll the deployment URL with bounded backoff, verify entry/assets/tuple startup and a minimal player run/restart using the exact artifact digest.
Record commit/artifact/page deployment identifiers and compare served JavaScript/assets with the qualified manifest.

Only after a candidate verification failure on an authorized update, execute the already qualified E02 rollback workflow using a retained known-good artifact/digest. Download, verify and re-upload it into the current run. A successful candidate stays live; no routine production rollback drill is run. Do not edit source/workflow files after E04.
On first-deployment failure record failed publication; on an update rollback automatically only when an existing authorized known-good artifact is available.
accept: ACC-PUBLISH-02 passes.

The candidate is marked published only while its verified bytes are live; project-prefix challenge links work. If recovery redeploys the old artifact, report rolled_back with that active artifact and the failed candidate, then return the defect to its owner rather than accepting this candidate release.
Rollback redeploys an immutable known-good artifact and reruns smoke verification without weakening protections.
No live status is marked published until verification succeeds.

tasks.title: Extract simulation and adapters after the release is stable
steps: Extract pure simulation, rendering, UI and storage behind the already accepted contracts in small commits.
Move legacy tests to module-based adapters while preserving coverage; retain the production debug exclusion already completed by A01/A02.
Keep one canonical entry and update the build without changing public behavior or rules version.
accept: Every existing acceptance case and deterministic trace passes unchanged.
Source-to-dist no longer relies on text injection for new tests; no second stale implementation is introduced.
Module ownership permits non-overlapping concurrent implementation only after interfaces are accepted.

tasks.title: Add one optional practice revive without affecting ranked rules
steps: Add an off-by-default pre-run Practice assist option. When enabled, create category=practice at run creation even if unused; it cannot be toggled during a live run. Maintain eight complete movement snapshots including cells, prey, clocks, RNG, score and metrics.

Intercept collision before finalization. Restore the snapshot four moves earlier, or the earliest available safe snapshot, with the same runId. Consume the one-revive flag outside restored history so rewinding cannot replenish it; cancel future events/history. If unavailable/declined/already consumed, finalize normally as practice.
Show a one-second paused ghost-trail countdown before explicit continuation, rather than allowing out-of-grid invulnerable movement.
Classify any assisted run as practice and keep it out of normal/daily rankings; update the historical G5 concept to this exact contract.
accept: Restoration reproduces the full earlier snapshot and cannot duplicate food/points or retain future RNG state.
Assistance is limited to once, normal/daily behavior remains unchanged when off, and assisted results are visibly practice.
Storage quota/unavailable snapshot falls back to normal death without breaking the game.

tasks.title: Add a same-challenge local best ghost
steps: Record canonical input events/movement timestamps only for eligible completed player runs; replay through the accepted simulator. Bound recording to 100000 input events; exceeding the limit disables that run's ghost recording, without interrupting play or score eligibility.
Store at most ten challenge replays and two MiB in IndexedDB, with deterministic LRU eviction; storage failure disables ghost persistence only.
Render a non-colliding translucent ribbon for the best replay with an exactly matching seed/mode/rules tuple; default off and use fewer samples on low tier.
Validate replay headers/state hashes and discard incompatible/corrupt traces without altering player state.
accept: Ghost playback is identical across rendering FPS and cannot consume player RNG, collide or change scoring.
Different challenge tuples never race each other; corrupt data and quota denial are safe.
Memory/draw-call budgets are bounded and no server/account is required.

execution.authorizationBasis: User instructed proceeding with implementation of PUBLIC_RELEASE_BACKLOG.md tasks, including conditional E05/E06 publication after qualification; no separate routine confirmation gate.

implementation_adjustments.decision: Declare browser installer, explicit suite registry and infrastructure regression paths discovered while implementing the already approved infrastructure requirements. No product scope change.

implementation_adjustments.reason: DEC04 tuple-derived hazard stream and explicit once-per-reset generation supersede the legacy static direct RNG.seed assertion; preserve equivalent hazard integration and all other checks.

Inject new mutable simulation advance/time/next-movement arrangements exclusively in source-test adapter for legacy timing migration; canonical source and actual production receive no new mutable globals.
Replace unsafe global debug sweep with invocation/child-owned cleanup and isolated concurrency retention proof. Existing A01 paths/locks cover narrow correction.
